title: Soft sunset orchestration — in-product upgrade nudges, cohort pilots, and release-note cadence
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: execute a staged, low-friction deprecation of legacy /v1 model endpoints using a soft-sunset approach that prioritizes user experience and throughput stability. This ticket coordinates the in-product upgrade nudges (contextual banners, modal walkthroughs), a sequence of customer cohort pilots (early adopters -> conservative -> broad), and the cross-team release notes + comms cadence. We aim to minimize support load while reaching 95% opt-in to the recommended newer endpoint within 10 weeks of the first in-product nudge for targeted cohorts. Scope: product UI + console messaging, migration self-serve flow, telemetry and rollback hooks, coordinated release notes and external comms, and support runbooks for stepped escalations.
acceptance_criteria: In-product upgrade path implemented: banner, modal, and single-click migration flow that preserves tenant settings and keys (QA signoff)
Cohort pilot schedule defined and populated in Customer Ops (3 cohorts: internal, beta customers, broad opt-in)
Release notes drafted and staged in release-notes repo; legal & security review completed for copy and data-handling language
Telemetry dashboards show baseline metrics and post-nudge telemetry (migration rate, error rate, latency delta) and alerting thresholds configured
Support playbook published with canned replies, rollback steps, and escalation matrix; triage drills completed with Support and SRE
rollout_timeline: Week 0 (2025-04-01): Feature flag merged behind pilot flag; internal dogfooding cohort enabled
Week 2 (2025-04-15): Beta cohort (10–20 customers) receive in-product nudge; begin 2-week observation window
Week 4 (2025-04-29): Evaluate pilot metrics; expand to conservative cohort (25% of eligible customers) if healthy
Week 7 (2025-05-20): Broad opt-in nudge rolled out with extended help center docs and automated migration path
Week 10 (2025-06-10): Soft-sunset window begins for remaining non-migrated customers; escalate comms cadence and offer concierge migration
communication_plan: Internal: weekly cross-functional sync (PM/Eng/Design/SRE/Support/Legal) every Monday 09:30 PT during rollout window
External: three-touch cadence for cohorts — initial in-product nudge (banner), follow-up email with migration checklist, final reminder with sunset date
Release notes: publish staged release notes entry in console-2025.05 with clear migration steps and links to self-serve tool; include migration impact summary in API changelog
Marketing & Sales: one-pager for customer success and AEs with migration benefits and escalation contacts; product webinar scheduled for Week 5
telemetry_and_success_metrics: Migration rate by cohort: target 95% for early adopters within 4 weeks of nudge
Regression guardrails: error rate increase <= 1.5x baseline OR absolute error rate <= 0.5% for migrated traffic
Performance delta: median latency change for migrated traffic <= +18ms; p95 remains within SLA
Support impact: no more than +15% support ticket volume attributable to migration per week for the first 6 weeks
Revenue/usage safeguards: ensure key customers maintain request throughput; monitor per-tenant throttle events
open_tasks: ENG: implement migration endpoint shim that transparently redirects compatible requests and preserves telemetry context (ENG-22134)
ENG: add feature flag gates and rollout automation (percentage ramps) with kill-switch (ENG-19876)
DES: craft banner and modal UX variations + in-product walkthrough flows; create A/B variants for messaging tests (DES-6742)
PM: finalize cohort list with Customer Ops and prepare customer-facing comms templates
Docs: publish migration guide with step-by-step CLI examples, SDK snippets, and rollback notes
Support: update internal KB and train L2 on migration troubleshooting; schedule two triage drills
notes_and_discussions: 2025-02-18: Kickoff w/Engineering & Design. Trade-off: single-click migration requires temporary shim vs. explicit export/import. Decision: go with shim + telemetry tagging for faster opt-in and easier rollback.
2025-02-26: Legal reviewed comms copy for EU data processing references; suggested addition of KMS note. Action: add KMS paragraph to release notes (Assigned: LegalOps).
2025-03-05: SRE requested additional canary traffic tests for prefix-heavy workloads. ENG added scheduled stress test before Week 2 expansion.
2025-03-10: Support & CS asked for migration concierge pilot (3 customers) — agreed; will run as opt-in during Week 7 expansion.
